event: Selected Exam Panic Rescue for Backyard AI
evidence: A narrow student exam-panic workflow is more useful and relatable than a generic productivity assistant or toy demo.
privacy_note: No private user data or fake traction is claimed.

evidence: One panic dump plus real topics and time left becomes one rescue packet with drills, triage clock, final sheet, study receipt, and field-note prompt.
privacy_note: Bundled scenarios are labeled as samples, not real-user data.

evidence: Live Space generation returned: Generated with openbmb/MiniCPM4.1-8B on CUDA/ZeroGPU.
privacy_note: Model output is generated from user-provided study topics.

event: Removed auto-generation from load and sample buttons
evidence: The Space now generates only after the explicit Build my rescue packet action, preserving ZeroGPU quota and making samples feel like templates instead of mock outcomes.
privacy_note: No generated sample output is shown before a user action.

evidence: Escaped model newlines are converted into real Markdown line breaks; an ML exam panic test produced readable practice questions and a survival plan.
privacy_note: The ML test used an artificial prompt for functional QA, not a claimed user study.

event: Fixed Hugging Face Space build failure
evidence: Pinned README sdk_version to 6.0.1 to match requirements.txt; live Space returned root/config smoke 4/4 after rebuild.
privacy_note: Public package audit excludes internal strategy docs and private scripts.

evidence: Off-Brand custom UI, no required cloud API, public field notes, this public build trace, and optional llama.cpp runtime evidence are the five targeted paths.
privacy_note: Well-Tuned is not claimed because there is no real fine-tuning dataset or published fine-tuned model.

event: Added optional NVIDIA Nemotron fallback path
evidence: NEMOTRON_FALLBACK_MODEL_ID defaults to nvidia/Nemotron-Mini-4B-Instruct and runs only when USE_NEMOTRON_FALLBACK=1; OpenBMB remains the default.
privacy_note: Nemotron Quest is not claimed until a real Nemotron fallback smoke is shown.
